scope: One bounded retrospective attempt to improve the dissertation result; no guaranteed positive outcome, no attack generation or replay
hypothesis: Training-only exact operation templates and categorical cross-entropy plus numeric Huber loss improve detection beyond novelty of previously unseen operation/endpoint signatures
design: Two encodings (hash/exact) x six methods (MSE-current, MSE-global, CE-current, CE-global, IsolationForest, DeepSVDD) x three seeds =36 fits
primary_model: exact/ce_global, fixed before training; other variants are ablations or predefined baselines, not a test-selected replacement
primary_threshold: Maximum score on original normal calibration set, frozen before test. Secondary original upper empirical .999 quantile. No search over thresholds using test labels. Maximum calibration score is a conservative choice, not a guarantee under distribution shift.
primary_success: Primary model must have actual FPR <=0.001 on both known-endpoint SMF normals and separate clean_holdout partition from the same normal capture in all seeds; also recall >=0.05 on the 646 known-endpoint positives whose OLD hashed endpoint-operation signature was seen in normal training, in all seeds. This is a fixed meaningful-effect criterion, not a claim that 5% recall alone suffices for deployment.
primary_population: 706 positive and 2509 normal known-endpoint SMF requests. Secondary hard-positive stratum646 remains defined using the previous hash representation so that recoding cannot redefine the difficult cases.
features: Same original train/calibration/test partitions and original scenario labels; original endpoint vocabulary; fixed 8-way method code; hash service/resource8/32 versus training-only exact normalized service/path vocabulary with explicit unknown0. Wire field, four causal log-gap and four count/diversity summaries. No responses, tokens, markers, labels, absolute time, scenario names, procedure IDs, or witness claims.
numeric: Original raw causal summaries reconstructed from pinned CSVs and aligned to original matrices. Training median and MAD with floor0.1, followed by monotone asinh; no hard clipping, no test fit. This numeric repair is common to all new cells and is not separately isolated in this experiment.
model: Input one-hot categories,8 numeric fields,4 mask indicators. Input projection48, GRU48 for strictly previous16 requests of full stream, otherwise zero history. Common three categorical heads and one8-dimensional numeric head. Four full-block masks, equal block weights. CE variant: categorical cross-entropy plus numeric Huber. MSE control: probability-vector MSE plus numeric MSE. Same parameter initialization/shapes within an encoding; exact/hash cardinalities differ and parameter counts are reported.
training: Normal-only original10317 requests;12epochs,512batch,AdamWlr.001weight_decay.0001clip5,twoCPUthreads,seeds11/29/47. No attack labels or test-based hyperparameter/epoch/model selection.
baselines: IsolationForest200trees,max_samples256; DeepSVDD published one-class objective and same bias-free64-32-16 tabular adaptation as previous experiment. Both receive each new encoding and the same normal training rows. No rules as competitors. Baselines do not receive an explicit sequence; CE-current ablation controls the added history.
report: Every model, both thresholds, full/known/old-seen strata, AP,recall,actualFPR,TP/FP,cleanFPR,conditional512-request200-replicate intervals,false alarms per capture hour. Compare recall only with actual FPR disclosed; do not claim matched-FPR superiority from unequal actual rates. All failures retained.
limitations: Data and labels have already been inspected; adaptive retrospective research, not a fresh blind test
No independent new deployments or verified malicious-outcome labels
No request-bound witnesses or true cross-function procedure histories
Signature novelty may still explain any success; decompose results
One favorable seed or a different favorable ablation is not primary success
Positive engineering performance does not alone establish dissertation novelty
